investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Maplecrest Finance (digital banking); Platform: on-premises data center DC-A, server range 10.23.0.0/16; Application tier: fx-rates-svc runs on dedicated rack servers behind a load balancer; IPMI sensor data and SEL are collected; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
